name: EmojiCharacterPicker
description: a picker for browsing and selecting emoji characters
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `role="grid"` -- identifies the container as a grid widget for structured cell navigation
`aria-label={label}` -- provides an accessible name for the emoji picker
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `label`: string (required) -- accessible name describing the picker, applied via `aria-label`
`children`: slot (required) -- the grid content containing emoji characters
